canonical_project: Beijing E-Town 2025 Data Center Whitelist Facilities
owner: 21Vianet / Sinnet / GDS and other Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area operators
notes: Beijing E-Town reports 12 data center projects operated by companies including 21Vianet, Sinnet, and GDS were selected for the 2025 whitelist and may receive compute and green-development support; the citywide 2024-2027 plan focuses on optimizing existing data centers and smart-compute transformation.
